mismatches.say: Coinsurance: insure at least a set share of the property's value, like eighty percent. Carry less, and every loss gets paid short, in proportion.
mismatches.heard: Co-insurance, ensure at least a set share of the property's value, like 80%. Carry less, and every loss gets paid short in proportion.

mismatches.say: Watch out: people away, but belongings still there? That's unoccupied, like a furnished house while its owners spend four months in Florida. Look for the stuff.
mismatches.heard: Watch out, people away but belonging still there. That's unoccupied, like a furnished house while its owners spend four months in Florida. Look for the stuff.

mismatches.say: The twenty twelve B P P has its own test: an owner's building is vacant unless at least thirty-one percent of its square footage is in use.
mismatches.heard: The 2012 BPP has its own test, and owners' building is vacant unless at least 31 percent of its square footage is in use.

mismatches.say: We're the named mortgagee. What do we do?
mismatches.heard: With a named mortgagee, what do we do?

mismatches.say: Apparent authority is what a reasonable person assumes from how the insurer presents her. A license alone gives neither.
mismatches.heard: A parent authority is what a reasonable person assumes from how the insurer presents her. A license alone gives neither.

mismatches.say: Did over Should, times the Loss, minus the Deductible, capped by the limit. Under the twenty twelve B P P, vacant over sixty days: some perils out, the rest cut fifteen percent. Subrogation: after paying, the insurer recovers from the party liable.
mismatches.heard: did overshould times the loss minus the deductible, capped by the limit. Under the 2012 BPP, vacant over 60 days, some perils out, the rest cut 15%. Subrogation, after paying, the insurer recovers from the party liable.

mismatches.say: A mortgagee can collect after a denial; a loss payee usually can't.
mismatches.heard: A mortgagee can collect after a denial. A lost payee usually cannot.

mismatches.say: A building worth five hundred thousand dollars at the time of loss is insured for three hundred thousand dollars with eighty percent coinsurance and a one thousand dollars deductible. A one hundred thousand dollars covered loss occurs. What does the insurer pay? A: fifty nine thousand dollars. B: seventy four thousand dollars. C: seventy four thousand two hundred fifty dollars. D: ninety nine thousand dollars.
mismatches.text: A building worth $500,000 at the time of loss is insured for $300,000 with 80% coinsurance and a $1,000 deductible. A $100,000 covered loss occurs. What does the insurer pay? A: $59,000. B: $74,000. C: $74,250. D: $99,000.

mismatches.say: What should the bank do? One: Give up: his denial sinks us too. Two: Sue the owner and win in court first. Three: File a sworn statement within sixty days.
mismatches.text: What should the bank do? One: Give up: his denial sinks us too. Two: Sue the owner and win in court first. Three: File a sworn statement within 60 days.
mismatches.heard: What should the bank do? One, give up, his denial syncs us too. Two, sue the owner and win in court first. Three, file a sworn statement within 60 days.

mismatches.say: The mortgagee's claim stands if it reports known changes in risk, pays premium due on demand, and files a sworn statement within sixty days after notice.
